references.text: Moses reminds the people that the Lord brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, with a strong hand.
The introduction to the Ten Commandments where the Lord identifies Himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
Moses tells how the Lord brought the people out of Egypt with great signs and wonders.
A reminder of the great signs and wonders that Israel saw when the Lord brought them out of Egypt.
Moses reminds the people of the great signs and wonders they saw in Egypt.
Israel saw the Lord's great act against the Egyptians, and the people feared the Lord.
God's promise to send His angel ahead of Israel to guard them on the way and bring them safely through the nations.
The account of how the Lord protected Israel as they traveled through the lands of the peoples.
The Lord blessed Israel in all they did and kept them safe during their journey through the wilderness.
A song of praise that honors the Lord for bringing Israel out of Egypt and leading them through the wilderness.
